notes:
Passed on the fake backend only (python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/harveybc__gym-fx --backend fake; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). The package is model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached and no hardware backend was run. No upstream package was installed or imported: GymFxEnv needs a config plus six plugin instances, a pandas CSV feed and backtrader (app/env.py:113-124), and gym_fx registers no Gymnasium environment id, so the sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not used. The fake is the package's own pure Python stand-in and was not compared with an upstream run. It covers only the default Discrete(3) action space (0 hold, 1 long, 2 short; app/env.py:8 and :181) and the default six-block observation of preprocessor_plugins/default_preprocessor.py:70-77; the fidelity gaps in driver.py disclose the missing backtrader fill engine, commissions, slippage, margin, solvency, stop-loss/take-profit orders, the continuous action mode, the optional feature/calendar/execution-cost observation blocks, the toy reward and the synthetic price series. Fidelity is F0 with timestep_ms 0 because a bar has no fixed duration (app/env.py:666-684). The warnings are the expected simulator-family ones and do not fail the gate: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only schedules the next reset; the bridge makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs ticks, action.index and seed (twice). G4 reported no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warning, and all 16 facts cite a clone line that shows the claim. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no extension ids and no catalogue requests. The gate digest is the digest printed by the last run; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
